checksum_model_validation.scope: Synthetic memory; exact checksum-helper instruction words; no hardware or whole-camera execution

arguments.a0: mode low8; zero calculates only, nonzero also copies
arguments.a1: destination pointer in copy mode; ignored for calculate-only

contracts.copy_mode: Copies N+1 bytes, offsets0..N inclusive; excludes final two copied bytes from sum
contracts.limits: N<=0 can underflow target loops; this host API rejects it. Overlap/null/alias behavior is not a supported public copying contract. No settings are written.

contracts.erase_position_rule: operation2 divides position from global0x80003258 by1<<u16(handle+0x11c4)
contracts.inference: selectors8/5/4 are erase-like/write-like/read-like based on position conversion, buffer direction and verification order

contracts.cache_rule: 0x808c1d88+4*(74*context_index+37*bank+subindex); context2/5 can fallback tocontext0 when its pointer is null

contracts.type0: calls0x8019e724 ->0x802e57a8 with driver object field+0x880 and retained command
contracts.type5: retains command payload in driver-owned command slots; no immediate hardware upload established

development_gates.explanation: A compiler output and valid packed patch are not proven placement, hook safety or recovery. Zero-filled gaps and unused bytes are not designated code caves.

limitations: This static pass does not prove all active saved-photo, driver, storage or boot paths.
A known menu update rollback requires a running application and is not unbootable recovery.
No arbitrary monitor, GetMem/SetMem, NAND dump or device command is invoked.
Original ELF headers/flags are retained, including absent ABI metadata; tiny loader profile is separate.
Settings checksum coverage is independent of the firmware-update additive checksum.
